title: Dissipative measure-valued solutions and weak--strong uniqueness for a viscous Baer--Nunziato system with pressure relaxation
summary: We study a viscous one-velocity Baer--Nunziato system for two barotropic compressible fluids in a bounded three-dimensional domain. In contrast with models in which the volume fraction is merely transported or determined by an algebraic equilibrium constraint, it satisfies a differential closure driven by the pressure gap between the phases.
